At Base block 52635892 (2026-10-15T10:45:31Z), the four current dashboard-listed Base wallets held 10773105.083138 USDC against ONED totalSupply of 10773105.01. The dashboard displayed 10773105.08 USDC and 10773105.01 ONED, refreshed 10/15/2026 10:43 AM, timezone unspecified, and identifies only the exact registered Base liability. These independently reproduced chain balances are not independent financial assurance or proof of absent off-chain liabilities. Coinbase US User Agreement Appendix 4 sections 13.1.1-13.1.3 gives holders transferable ownership and all economic value and risk of corresponding USDC, establishing a wrapper/serial claim. Incorporated section 2.7 provides contractual custody safeguards, subject to its exceptions, without proving statutory bankruptcy remoteness or executable redemption capacity.

sources.label: Coinbase US User Agreement, Appendix 4 section 13.1.3 incorporating sections 2.7.1-2.7.4

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Native ONED holder terms expressly incorporate and give precedence to Coinbase's terms. Appendix 4 section 13.1.3 retains reserve title for CCS holders and incorporates section 2.7. Section 2.7.1 states that custodial assets are not Coinbase property or subject to its creditors' claims and prohibits sale, lending, security interests and hypothecation except as required by law, instructed by the holder or under applicable Secured USDC terms. These are contractual safeguards, not verified statutory bankruptcy remoteness. Section 2.7.4 permits shared blockchain addresses while maintaining separate ledgers; no dedicated-address segregation is promised. Actual compliance, reserve encumbrance, a token-specific trust and custodian-failure/replacement or recovery arrangements remain unverified. Section 13.3.3 limits Coinbase's shortfall liability to the holder's pro-rata share.
